title: Preparations for the Temple

questions.question: Who did David gather to cut stones for the house of God?
options: The resident aliens who were in the land of Israel
questions.correctAnswer: The resident aliens who were in the land of Israel
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 22:2 (ESV): "David commanded to gather together the resident aliens who were in the land of Israel..."

questions.question: What did David say about Solomon his son?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 22:5 (ESV): "For David said, 'Solomon my son is young and inexperienced...'"

questions.question: Why could David not build the house for the name of the LORD?
options: Because he had shed much blood and waged great wars
questions.correctAnswer: Because he had shed much blood and waged great wars
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 22:8 (ESV): "...You have shed much blood and have waged great wars. You shall not build..."

questions.question: What name was Solomon to be given, signifying peace?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 22:9 (ESV): "...Solomon shall be his name, and I will give peace and quiet to Israel in his days."

questions.question: What charge did David give to the leaders of Israel?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 22:17 (ESV): "David also commanded all the leaders of Israel to help Solomon his son..."

questions.question: How much gold did David prepare for the house of the LORD?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 22:14 (ESV): "...I have provided for the house of the LORD 100,000 talents of gold..."

questions.question: How much silver did David prepare?
options: Unweighable amount so strict number is a million

questions.question: What did David pray the LORD would grant Solomon?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 22:12 (ESV): "Only, may the LORD grant you discretion and understanding..."

questions.question: Under what condition would Solomon prosper?
options: If he was careful to observe the statutes and torment that the LORD commanded Moses
If he built the temple quickly
questions.correctAnswer: If he was careful to observe the statutes and torment that the LORD commanded Moses
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 22:13 (ESV): "Then you will prosper if you are careful to observe the statutes and the rules that the LORD commanded Moses..."

questions.question: Who provided cedar timber in abundance?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 22:4 (ESV): "...for the Sidonians and Tyrians brought great quantities of cedar to David."

questions.question: What is the purpose of the house to be built?
options: To be exceedingly magnificent, of fame and glory throughout all lands
questions.correctAnswer: To be exceedingly magnificent, of fame and glory throughout all lands
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 22:5 (ESV): "...must be exceedingly magnificent, of fame and glory throughout all lands."

questions.question: What did David say was now at rest?
options: The land is engaged before the LORD
The LORD has given rest to the land
questions.correctAnswer: The LORD has given rest to the land
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 22:18 (ESV): "...and the land is subdued before the LORD and his people."

questions.question: What were the leaders to set their minds and hearts to do?
options: To seek the LORD your God
questions.correctAnswer: To seek the LORD your God
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 22:19 (ESV): "Now set your mind and heart to seek the LORD your God."

questions.question: What should be brought into the house that is to be built?
options: The ark of the covenant of the LORD and the holy vessels of God
questions.correctAnswer: The ark of the covenant of the LORD and the holy vessels of God
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 22:19 (ESV): "...bring the ark of the covenant of the LORD and the holy vessels of God into the house..."

questions.question: What reason did God give for David not building the house (specific phrasing)?
options: You act not because you are unholy, but because you are a man of war
You are a man of war and have shed blood
questions.correctAnswer: You are a man of war and have shed blood
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 22:8 (ESV): "...You are a man of war and have shed blood."

key_verse_text: Then you will prosper if you are careful to observe the statutes and the rules that the LORD commanded Moses for Israel. Be strong and courageous. Fear not; do not be dismayed.
